verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs list ISO 27001 among the frameworks it manages in one place, alongside pre-mapped controls, audit-ready reports, evidence collection, and in-platform auditor collaboration and audit-partner selection. None of this shows ISO 27001 treated as a first-class framework rather than a mapped one. missing for 10: evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation or management, ISO-specific certification-audit artifacts (e.g., ISMS scope, internal audit, management review), and independent or hands-on corroboration of ISO 27001 depth.
